name: bricks-builder
title: Bricks Builder
description: Open pages and templates in Bricks Builder, search classes, colors and elements, and manage all your Bricks sites.
author: matejmohar

commands.name: search-shortcuts
commands.title: Search Bricks Shortcuts
commands.description: Search Bricks Builder keyboard shortcuts, copy them, or press them in the builder.

preferences.name: keyStyle
preferences.title: Key Style
preferences.description: How shortcuts are displayed and copied.

commands.name: open-in-bricks
commands.title: Open in Bricks
commands.description: Search pages, posts and Bricks templates on your sites and open them in the builder, or create new ones.

commands.name: edit-current-page
commands.title: Edit Current Page in Bricks
commands.description: Open the page in your browser's current tab in Bricks, or go back to the live page from the builder.

commands.name: search-global-classes
commands.title: Search Global Classes
commands.description: Search the global classes of a Bricks site and copy or paste their names.

commands.name: search-colors-variables
commands.title: Search Colors and Variables
commands.description: Search a Bricks site's color palettes and global CSS variables.

commands.name: search-dynamic-data
commands.title: Search Dynamic Data
commands.description: Every dynamic data tag on a Bricks site: Bricks, ACF, Meta Box, JetEngine and more. Paste one into the builder.

commands.name: search-elements
commands.title: Search Bricks Elements
commands.description: Search every Bricks element on a site, across pages, templates and components, by text, class, color, CSS or element type.

commands.name: site-info
commands.title: Bricks Site Info
commands.description: Show breakpoints with their media queries, theme styles and their conditions, states, CSS loading method and Bricks version of your site.

commands.name: site-audit
commands.title: Bricks Site Audit
commands.description: Unused global classes (trash and restore), templates without conditions, Code elements, images without alt text and the heaviest pages.

preferences.name: largeImageKb
preferences.title: Large Image Threshold
preferences.description: Images whose served file is bigger than this many KB count as large.

commands.name: template-library
commands.title: Bricks Template Library
commands.description: Browse a site's Bricks templates and global components with a structure preview, and paste them into the builder on any site.

commands.name: form-submissions
commands.title: Bricks Form Submissions
commands.description: Browse the form submissions a Bricks site saved, by form, and reply, copy or delete them.

commands.name: form-submissions-menu-bar
commands.title: New Bricks Form Submissions
commands.description: Shows new form submissions on all your Bricks sites in the menu bar.

commands.name: bricks-snippets
commands.title: Search Bricks Snippets
commands.description: Your library of Bricks elements, CSS, JS and HTML snippets to paste into the builder.

commands.name: save-clipboard-snippet
commands.title: Save Clipboard as Bricks Snippet
commands.description: Save what's on the clipboard, such as elements copied in Bricks with ⌘C, as a snippet.

commands.name: search-docs
commands.title: Search Bricks Docs
commands.description: Search Bricks Academy articles and read them in Raycast.

commands.name: press-shortcut
commands.title: Press Bricks Shortcut
commands.description: Presses one Bricks shortcut in the builder. Used for hotkeys made with ⌘⇧K in Search Bricks Shortcuts.

commands.name: site-health
commands.title: Bricks Site Health
commands.description: All your Bricks sites at a glance: Bricks, helper, WordPress and PHP versions, available updates, maintenance mode and connection problems.

commands.name: toggle-maintenance-mode
commands.title: Toggle Bricks Maintenance Mode
commands.description: Turns Bricks maintenance mode on or off on the selected site, after asking.

commands.name: regenerate-css
commands.title: Regenerate Bricks CSS Files
commands.description: Regenerates Bricks' CSS files on the selected site.

commands.name: clear-caches
commands.title: Clear Bricks Site Caches
commands.description: Flushes the object cache and page cache plugins (LiteSpeed, WP Rocket, W3TC, WP Super Cache, SiteGround, FlyingPress and more) on the selected site.

commands.name: regenerate-code-signatures
commands.title: Regenerate Bricks Code Signatures
commands.description: Signs every Code element, SVG and query editor again on the selected site, after asking.

commands.name: bricks-pro
commands.title: Bricks Raycast Pro
commands.description: Add your Bricks Raycast Pro license key, see which sites have Pro, and activate it on one site or all of them.

commands.name: manage-sites
commands.title: Manage Bricks Sites
commands.description: Add, edit or remove the WordPress sites used by Open in Bricks.

scripts.publish: node scripts/check-screenshots.js && node scripts/helper-zip.js --check && npx @raycast/api@latest publish
